title: Character Prompt Builder Pack Record File
description: A kind-specific record container used inside a Character Prompt Builder content pack.

service.description: The service, by the key it has in the service-profiles resource.

model_identifier.description: The model's identifier on that service.

request_keys.description: The request key each input occupies, by role: model, prompt, negative prompt, reference images, seed image, mask image, input image, guidance prompt, and for the image size either width and height or one size key whose text size_format writes. The value is an array because a role may need more than one key; a role whose name ends in images occupies a list. A generation offering names its prompt; one without a negative prompt says the target has no negative field, and one without a model says the address names the model.

size_format.description: How the text of the size request key is written: {width} and {height} are the sides in pixels, {ratio_width} and {ratio_height} the two numbers of the aspect ratio, such as {width}x{height} or {ratio_width}:{ratio_height}.

constraints.description: The limits the service enforces for this model, in the offering's own words; the observed schema is the machine-checked form.

setting_keys.description: For an upscaler: the request key each setting the record declares occupies on this service. A declared setting with no key here cannot be sent.

parameter_keys.description: The request key each of the record's recommended_parameters occupies on this service. A recommendation with no key here is not sent through this service.

schema_snapshot.description: Path, relative to the pack root, of the service's parameter schema for this model as observed.

observed_profile.description: The adopted observed request profile a measured basis rests on: a /-separated path inside the pack that holds the model record, and its SHA-256.

species-scaffold.description: The prompt-prior scaffold family a species record calibrates face geometry against. The user's species and the approved Character Identity Contract stay the identity authority; the scaffold only guides geometry wording.

family.description: The scaffold family whose prompt prior calibrates face geometry. Each value describes the geometry it invokes.

confidence.description: direct: the family is the species' own. nearest: the closest family. fallback: the family is direct-geometry-required.

status.description: The outcome of the family's latest boundary review.

evidence_basis.description: The materially different scenes or sources that show the finish recurring.

recurring_axes.description: The finish axes that recur across the evidence.

excluded_scene_attributes.description: Scene content removed from the family grammar, such as a location or a pose.

nearest_family.description: The id of the closest other style family, from any enabled pack.

boundary.description: The visible rules that separate this family from its nearest family.

deferred_candidates.description: Proposed families compared against this one and kept out of the catalog.

prompt_dialect.description: The family whose prompt grammar and vocabulary this model reads, by its id in the prompt-dialects resource. A record without one is not read as a tag target.

upscale_settings.description: The settings this upscaler accepts, each named by the record and mapped to a request key by the offering. An empty object says the model takes none.

recommended_parameters.description: Reusable recommended values or numeric ranges by neutral name. Required mode controls may resolve a single value through their named recommendation. Ranges require an explicit choice. Each effective choice is recorded.

offerings.description: How each service exposes this model: one entry per service, empty when no service here exposes it. A request through a service is checked against its offering and, when the offering points at one, the service's observed parameter schema.

observed_profile.description: The adopted observed request profile a measured basis rests on: a /-separated path inside the pack that holds the model record, and its SHA-256.
